mapping.draft_py:
# Boros Charm (FDN) -- Choose one --
#  * Boros Charm deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
#      M21 Chandra's Magmutt's B3-deal-dmg-const-player-or-planeswalker target, amount 4.
#  * Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
#      M21 Heroic Intervention's B5b-perm-hex-ind INDESTRUCTIBLE step (ALL CONTROLLER_IS YOU).
#  * Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
#      M21 Gale Swooper's TARGET creature grant, DOUBLE_STRIKE.
# Modal shape: Destructive Tampering's Choose(count 1).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Choose(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            options=(
                A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
                    'amount': QConst(value=4),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                        filter=FOr(
                            children=(
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
                                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(
                            Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
                            Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
                        ),
                    ),
                }),
                A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.INDESTRUCTIBLE),
                    'duration': DurationEot(),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QUnbounded(),
                        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
                A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.DOUBLE_STRIKE),
                    'duration': DurationEot(),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
]

mapping.notes: Choose(count 1): Chandra's Magmutt's 'target player or planeswalker' (4); Heroic Intervention's INDESTRUCTIBLE grant over permanents you control; Gale Swooper's target grant with DOUBLE_STRIKE; all grants until end of turn. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: boros_charm_four_to_a_planeswalker, boros_charm_indestructible_locks_in_its_permanents (CR 611.2c).

clauses.evidence: Three casts announce one mode each ('cast modes=[0]', '[1]', '[2]'), each with its own slot or none; only the chosen mode's effect happens.

clauses.clause: Boros Charm deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0] targets=[you]]: 'you is dealt 4 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)', life 20 -> 16; [targets=[opp]]: opp 20 -> 16; the slot is 1..1 of [you, opp] - no creature is offered. The planeswalker half is not on the board: pack C10_1 (an opposing Vivien Reid goes 5 -> 1 loyalty; a creature target is refused).

clauses.clause: Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[1]]: keywords +INDESTRUCTIBLE on you_bear, you_charm, you_giant, you_land and you_relic (creatures, an enchantment, a land, an artifact - everything of mine) and on none of the opponent's; all five lose it 'after the turn ends'. Pack C10_3 pins that a permanent entering afterwards is not covered (CR 611.2c) and that the opponent's permanents are not.

clauses.clause: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[2] targets=[you_bear]] and the five others (slot 1..1 of all six creatures): the target gets +DOUBLE_STRIKE and loses it 'after the turn ends'; nothing else changes. Pack C10_5: in combat the targeted 2/2 deals 2 + 2 and the untargeted creature deals its damage once.
